findings.summary: Regenerate deletes the user message and later ones before admission/AI open; a refusal loses the message and orphans its owned image. Pre-existing ordering at HEAD; carried to a later phase.
x-internal-service-token no longer stripped. Rejected: criterion 2 requires the name gone from every .ts file and no service reads it; any x-* header is inert upstream.
Client abort logged as Upstream error ECONNRESET. Fixed: onProxyError returns early when res is destroyed.
SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRY_SWEEP_MS undocumented. Fixed: added to deploy/env/finance.env.example.
ownedMessage mapped DB errors to 404. Fixed: only NotFoundException becomes Message not found; others rethrow.
OCR wait keeps polling after the SSE client aborts.
In-flight benefits read can write stale value back after invalidation, up to 5 min TTL.
Destructive drop without copy/rollback, per locked DB-reset policy.
